description: Wireless Applications Corp offers a suite of web service application programming interfaces for telecom infrastructure analysis that carriers, tower companies, web developers and wireless service providers can call from their own software. The page describes functions such as signal strength and coverage analysis, microwave coordination and interference analysis, frequency analysis, FAA and FCC regulatory filing support and site-specific tower reports, and says developers can sign up for a free developer key and find samples in PHP, C#, JavaScript and Objective C, plus simple examples of telecom functions and map integration. Producer: Wireless Applications Corp, a US wireless engineering firm that also runs the SiteSync Pro platform. Coverage: focused on the United States, judging by the FAA and FCC filing services. Access: sign up on the website for a developer key; usage limits and prices beyond the free key are not stated on the page read, so the cost is recorded as freemium. Licence and cost: commercial service, terms not read. Caveats: the page is marketing text with no parameter documentation, accuracy figures or data coverage, and the product's data sources were not confirmed. Simulation uses: it can supply propagation, coverage and interference calculations to capacity-planning and site-selection workflows for telecom networks. Related record: RadioPlanner, a commercial RF planning tool (platform-radioplanner).
